public_facts.scene: A single pink sheet of paper lies flat on the table, ahead of the arm and to its right (negative Y). A loose white paper tape measure lies to the left; ignore it. A second arm to the left is parked and must not be touched.
public_facts.reset_requirement: Operator places the sheet flat and records a reset ID.
public_facts.camera_notes: Wrist camera rotates with wrist roll; jaws close along the image's horizontal axis. Side camera looks across the table from the front; this arm is on the right of that view. Use wrist for XY alignment and side for height.
public_facts.contact_notes: A sideways stroke with the closed tips below about 18 mm clearance touches the sheet; the reply then says 'stopped early' with a wrist_yaw residual of several degrees. That is normal contact, not a fault: lift 3 cm and continue. Flat paper cannot be pinched; raise an edge first.
